 Job Opportunity! 


 
 
 
 
 
 
 Node.js API & Backend Developer
 
 
 Development & Tech
 
 
 API Development 
 
 

 
 We are looking for a skilled and reliable Node.js API & Backend Developer to develop, improve, and maintain secure, scalable, and high-performance backend systems for web and mobile applications. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience building backend services and working with databases, APIs, and modern server-side technologies.

The developer will be responsible for building and maintaining REST APIs, implementing server-side logic, designing and managing database structures, integrating third-party services, and implementing secure authentication and authorization. You will also troubleshoot backend issues, optimize application performance, handle API validation and error management, and ensure that backend services are reliable and maintainable.

You will work closely with frontend developers to connect APIs with web and mobile interfaces, resolve integration issues, and ensure smooth application functionality from development through deployment.

Candidates should have previous experience developing Node.js backend applications and APIs and be comfortable working independently while meeting project deadlines.

Applicants should provide a GitHub profile, portfolio, or examples of previous Node.js/backend projects when applying. Please briefly explain your experience and your role in the projects you share.
